track.title: Gusheh-e Moshtarak 9: Feyli
track.notes: A gushe shared by several dastgah-ha (gusheh-ye moshtarak); the album does not say which dastgah it is played in here. In his radif albums Alizadeh plays Feyli in Bayat-e Tork, Mahur. Its tonic is its own voted finalis.

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on C3 and dwells most on D in Feyli. The line peaks at D5 (589.5 Hz) at 0:38.3. It closes on the tonic (B4 → Fs4 → Fs4 → G4 → G4 → G4).
